name: CA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 6 points on the partisan baseline
Incumbent Ami Bera holds a large financial advantage ($1.8M vs $16K cash)
Prediction markets price Bera at 95-96% to win
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Bera: a Democratic-leaning district, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising edge over Robb Tucker, who has almost no cash on hand. Markets at 95-96% for Bera corroborate a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Bera or unexpectedly strong Republican turnout could narrow the margin, though an upset remains unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Ami Bera, the Democratic incumbent, advanced to the general election in a district that leans Democratic by about six points. He has raised $1.25 million and holds $1.8 million on hand, while Republican Robb Tucker has raised roughly $258,000 with only $16,000 remaining, leaving Tucker little capacity to close the gap.

No public general-election polls cover the race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing. Prediction markets put Bera's chances at 95 to 96 percent, consistent with a Safe D rating. The expected margin is roughly 19 points, with meaningful uncertainty given the absence of polling.
